text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before the start of the Kobe Shimbun 
Hai, it was announced that her classmate 
Tanino Gimlet would be sidelined from 
racing for an extended period due to an 
injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle is shaken. Symboli Kris S, 
on the other hand, remains completely 
calm. The race between the two begins.
